title: Savante verdict record
description: One entry of the Savante verdict ledger: a rendered five-field verdict bound to the exact charter, persona and doctrine root that rendered it. Records chain by prev_record_cid into an append-only list a stranger can walk. HONEST LABEL: the ledger has ZERO entries. The first verdict (2026-07-26, parsec-wallet, APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS) is asserted in prose (README.md:134-136) with no artifact committed, so it is not yet a ledger entry. countersignature is null because no signing executor exists: today a forged record is detectable by the digests it fails to match, not by a signature it cannot forge. That gap is named here; the deciding action is an executor holding an unexpired RENDER_VERDICT grant, at which point this schema is revised to admit a signature. verdict is a closed enum of exactly four values so a fifth value fails validation mechanically rather than by prose.

record.description: 1-based position in the append-only list. No record 1 exists yet.

prev_record_cid.description: CIDv1 (raw, sha2-256, base32) of the previous record's canonical bytes; null only for record 1.

chain.description: eip155:<chainId> of the registry the office is bound to; null while nothing is minted.

contract.description: identity registry address; null while nothing is minted.

token_id.description: agentId (ERC-721 tokenId); a decimal string when it exceeds 2^53; null while nothing is minted.

charter_sha256.description: sha256 of the raw bytes of .claude/agents/savante.md that rendered this verdict.

persona_sha256.description: sha256 of the raw bytes of savante.persona that rendered this verdict.

doctrine_root.description: keccak256 over the fifteen doctrine pointers in fixed order (savante.commitments.json doctrine_root.construction).

engine.description: the model that carried the session — recorded, never pinned (technical.md:48-50)

evidence.description: file:line citations, test counts, transaction hashes — what was read, not what was inferred

epistemic_state.description: the persona's closed vocabulary (savante.persona:94-97); there is no third state

deciding_experiment.description: required in substance whenever epistemic_state is not_yet_known

rationale.description: 2-5 sentences, board-minute style, citing the deciding doctrine or constraint.

conditions.description: numbered by position; each independently verifiable by someone who is not the officer.

rendered_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the rendering session.

record_cid.description: CIDv1 of this record's canonical bytes with this field set to null; null during canonicalization.

countersignature.description: null until a signing executor exists; no such executor or key exists today. Admitting a signature is a schema revision, not a value change.
